cost.note: The public guide makes payment mandatory before booking but gives no current amount or actionable fee schedule.

documents.note: The official evidence names actionable document categories and the originals-and-copies requirement.

eligibility.note: The official category guidance defines the fresh ordinary-passport route.

time.note: The published timing applies to dispatch after pre-police verification; it is not a whole-service completion promise.

owner.note: The Bengaluru Regional Passport Office is named and the Passport Office's verification decision is stated.

after-submission.note: The public guide describes an ARN and appointment confirmation shown after submitting or paying; no personal result was accessed.
